\section[sūkṣikkaṇē]{\ml{സൂക്ഷിക്കണേ} (sūkṣikkaṇē) — take care}

\label{lesson:ML-C127-takecare}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for English, then the Malayalam for office.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{സൂക്ഷിക്കണേ}}
\textbf{\ml{സൂക്ഷിക്കണേ}} (\emph{sūkṣikkaṇē}) — \textquotedblleft{}take care\textquotedblright{}, a warm word at the door.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
A caring goodbye.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sūkṣikkaṇē}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sūkṣikkaṇē}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{sūkṣikkaṇē!}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for English, then the Malayalam for office, then say \emph{sūkṣikkaṇē} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{സൂക്ഷിക്കണേ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Take care\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[vaiki]{\ml{വൈകി} (vaiki) — it's late, I'm late}

Before the new one: say the Malayalam for office, then the Malayalam for take care.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The reason people stand up to leave.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vaiki}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{vaiki}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for office, then the Malayalam for take care, then say \emph{vaiki} again

\section[(dialogue)]{How are you, really? — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R127-first-pass-body-feelings-repair}



\begin{quote}
Tomorrow is a holiday. Say so, and promise to call.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item you have a cold, a headache and dizziness; you are not well; tell a friend to rest
  \item name sadness, fear, anger, laughter and worry
  \item you are thirsty; name sweat, a tablet, vomiting and a wound
  \item it's cold; it's hot; you're sleepy; name mist, and thunder and lightning
  \item slowly; once more; louder; the meaning; please wait
  \item please show me; I didn't hear; I didn't understand; please help; please stop here
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A cold? (\textbf{\ml{ജലദോഷം}}.) Headache? (\textbf{\ml{തലവേദന}}.) Rest? (\textbf{\ml{വിശ്രമം}}.) Dizziness? (\textbf{\ml{തലകറക്കം}}.) Not well? (\textbf{\ml{സുഖമില്ല}}.) Sadness, fear, anger, laughter, worry? (\textbf{\ml{സങ്കടം}, \ml{പേടി}, \ml{ദേഷ്യം}, \ml{ചിരി}, \ml{ആശങ്ക}}.) Thirst? (\textbf{\ml{ദാഹം}}.) Sweat? (\textbf{\ml{വിയർപ്പ്}}.) Tablet? (\textbf{\ml{ഗുളിക}}.) Vomiting? (\textbf{\ml{ഛർദ്ദി}}.) Wound? (\textbf{\ml{മുറിവ്}}.) Cold, heat, sleep, mist, thunder? (\textbf{\ml{തണുപ്പ്}, \ml{ചൂട്}, \ml{ഉറക്കം}, \ml{മഞ്ഞ്}, \ml{ഇടിമിന്നൽ}}.) Slowly? (\textbf{\ml{പതുക്കെ}}.) Once more? (\textbf{\ml{ഒന്നുകൂടി}}.) Loudly? (\textbf{\ml{ഉറക്കെ}}.) Meaning? (\textbf{\ml{അർത്ഥം}}.) Wait? (\textbf{\ml{കാത്തിരിക്കൂ}}.) Show? (\textbf{\ml{കാണിക്കൂ}}.) Didn't hear? (\textbf{\ml{കേട്ടില്ല}}.) Didn't understand? (\textbf{\ml{മനസ്സിലായില്ല}}.) Help? (\textbf{\ml{സഹായിക്കൂ}}.) Stop? (\textbf{\ml{നിർത്തൂ}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Out, about and home again — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R127-second-pass-travel-replies-people}



\begin{quote}
Ask someone to call a taxi, and ask for one ticket.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item name a bus, a station and a map
  \item really?; nothing; oh no!; that very one; oh, I see
  \item not possible; not like that; maybe; a different one; wrong
  \item congratulations; an invitation; a gift; welcome; good wishes
  \item name a grandchild, a relative, the neighbours, an uncle and a nephew
  \item ask an address; name a wedding, a language, English and an office
  \item take care; it's late; let's go; a holiday; I'll call
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Call? (\textbf{\ml{വിളിക്കൂ}}.) Ticket, bus, station, map? (\textbf{\ml{ടിക്കറ്റ്}, \ml{ബസ്}, \ml{സ്റ്റേഷൻ}, \ml{ഭൂപടം}}.) Really? (\textbf{\ml{ശരിക്കും}}.) Nothing? (\textbf{\ml{ഒന്നുമില്ല}}.) Oh no? (\textbf{\ml{അയ്യോ}}.) The same? (\textbf{\ml{അതുതന്നെ}}.) Oh, I see? (\textbf{\ml{ഓഹോ}}.) Not possible? (\textbf{\ml{പറ്റില്ല}}.) Not like that? (\textbf{\ml{അങ്ങനെയല്ല}}.) Maybe? (\textbf{\ml{ആയിരിക്കാം}}.) Other? (\textbf{\ml{വേറെ}}.) Wrong? (\textbf{\ml{തെറ്റ്}}.) Congratulations? (\textbf{\ml{അഭിനന്ദനങ്ങൾ}}.) Invitation? (\textbf{\ml{ക്ഷണം}}.) Gift? (\textbf{\ml{സമ്മാനം}}.) Welcome? (\textbf{\ml{സ്വാഗതം}}.) Wishes? (\textbf{\ml{ആശംസകൾ}}.) Grandchild? (\textbf{\ml{പേരക്കുട്ടി}}.) Relative? (\textbf{\ml{ബന്ധു}}.) Neighbours? (\textbf{\ml{അയൽക്കാർ}}.) Uncle? (\textbf{\ml{അമ്മാവൻ}}.) Nephew? (\textbf{\ml{മരുമകൻ}}.) Address? (\textbf{\ml{വിലാസം}}.) Wedding? (\textbf{\ml{കല്യാണം}}.) Language? (\textbf{\ml{ഭാഷ}}.) English? (\textbf{\ml{ഇംഗ്ലീഷ്}}.) Office? (\textbf{\ml{ഓഫീസ്}}.) Take care? (\textbf{\ml{സൂക്ഷിക്കണേ}}.) Late? (\textbf{\ml{വൈകി}}.) Let's go? (\textbf{\ml{പോകാം}}.) Holiday? (\textbf{\ml{അവധി}}.) I'll call? (\textbf{\ml{വിളിക്കാം}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
